reference.title: General Settings
reference.shortdesc: Configure DITA-OT path and basic DITA Craft settings.

section.title: ditacraft.ditaOtPath
section.p: The path to your DITA Open Toolkit installation directory. This setting is required for publishing features. Run DITA: Install DITA-OT to install a release automatically.
section.note: Use forward slashes (/) in paths, even on Windows. VS Code handles path conversion automatically.

ol.li: Run DITA: Configure DITA-OT Path from Command Palette, or
Set the value manually in settings.json

section.p: DITA Craft verifies the path by checking for:

ul.li: lib/ directory with required JAR files

section.title: ditacraft.ditaOtInstallTargetDir
section.p: Default: "" (empty: choose a folder each time)
Folder in which DITA: Install DITA-OT creates the dita-ot-<version> directory. Supports ${workspaceFolder}.

section.title: ditacraft.ditaOtPreferredVersion
section.p: DITA-OT version preselected in the install version picker, for example 4.4.2.

section.title: ditacraft.ditaOtRegistryUrl
section.p: Base URL of the DITA-OT plugin registry used by DITA: Manage DITA-OT Plugins. Only http and https URLs are accepted; otherwise the default is used.

section.title: Java Configuration
section.p: DITA-OT requires Java 11 or higher. DITA Craft uses the following to locate Java:
If Java is not found, publishing will fail with a "Java not found" error.

section.title: Workspace Detection
section.p: DITA Craft automatically detects workspace context:

ul.li: Single Folder: Uses the folder as the workspace root
Multi-root Workspace: Uses the folder containing the current file
No Workspace: Uses the directory of the current file

section.p: This affects relative path resolution for href, conref, and key definitions.
